opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200, £500, £750, £300 depending on scheme

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva; UK‑based for non‑Society meetings.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientists at conferences (Society, SIG, non‑Society, virtual) with travel, accommodation and registration support.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a UK‑based training course.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to attend short training courses or collaborative lab visits for genetics‑related techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel and accommodation for field‑based genetic research projects, with awards typically up to £1,700.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Sponsorship up to several thousand pounds; typical major sponsorship £1,000‑£2,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members may apply at any time; applications should be submitted at least three months before the event.
opportunities.summary: Provides sponsorship for genetics‑themed meetings not organised by the Society, including potential Carer’s Awards.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, covering travel and material costs up to £1,000.
